subject.title: Add Model and Token Usage Status Display to Control UI Topbar

question: Should the Control UI add a persistent topbar display for active model plus token or provider usage, or should existing Chat, Usage, Overview, /status, and /usage surfaces remain the supported placement?
rationale: The missing topbar surface is source-proven, but the status meaning, freshness semantics, and responsive density require maintainer product/UX intent before implementation.

options.title: Define a compact topbar contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify which canonical session/model/provider-usage fields may appear in the topbar, including stale and unavailable states.

options.title: Decline topbar placement
options.body: Close after a maintainer decision and point users to Chat, Usage, Overview, /status, and /usage as the supported model and usage surfaces.

options.title: Narrow to chat-only usage
options.body: Track token widget work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62167 and leave active-model topbar placement out of scope.

recommendation.title: Define a compact topbar contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify which canonical session/model/provider-usage fields may appear in the topbar, including stale and unavailable states.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior review context on this issue and recent adjacent provider billing/UI work.
